title: SHOPLINE Developer MCP
description: Official SHOPLINE stdio MCP for searching developer documentation, inspecting Admin REST API definitions and Storefront GraphQL schemas, and validating GraphQL code.

authentication.reason: SHOPLINE's official MCP documentation states that the stdio server runs locally and does not require authentication. The credential-free runtime acceptance passed.

probe.reason: Credential-free stdio initialize returned SHOPLINE Developer MCP 1.1.0 with protocol version 2025-06-18.

reasons: authority 25/25: SHOPLINE publishes the MCP launch configuration on its own developer domain and owns the npm namespace
accessibility 25/25: version-pinned stdio package starts without credentials
maintenance/security 18/20: MIT metadata and official package maintainer verified; no public source repository was declared
runtime 15/15: initialize, tools/list, and a read-only documentation search passed
market gap 8/10: adds official ecommerce developer documentation and API schema tooling
documentation 5/5: official setup, usage examples, and tool inventory are public

review.notes: DuHu 已复核 SHOPLINE 官方文档、npm 包归属、免鉴权 stdio 配置、MIT 许可证元数据、版本固定策略、脱敏运行报告、服务端工具描述不可信边界与反馈工具的外部发送副作用，批准迁入正式记录并生成 Connector 卡片。
